name: @wizeworks/commerce-indexer
description: sparx search indexer. Cloud Run Pub/Sub push worker. Consumes catalog events (product.*, variant.*, inventory.adjusted) and — once the customer/order bridges land — crm.customer.* / order.* events, reprojecting the affected entity into Typesense via @wizeworks/commerce's projections + @wizeworks/search. Also runs admin-triggered full reindexes (search.reindex.requested).
